test_title: SSC Stenographer 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 10 Dec, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.

Doctor wants Tony __to cut back down__ junk foods.
solution:
The correct answer is '**to cut back on**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase "**to cut back on**" means to reduce the amount of something, which is the intended meaning in the given sentence.
 
• **Options 2, 3,** and **4** are incorrect because they do not fit the context of reducing the intake of junk foods.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

**Complete Sentence:** *"Doctor wants Tony to **cut back on**__ junk foods."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2: "to cut back over"** is incorrect because "cut back over" is not a standard phrase in English.
 
• **Option 3: "to cut back out"** is incorrect because "cut back out" is not a standard phrase in English.
 
• **Option 4: "to cut back off"** is incorrect because "cut back off" is not a standard phrase in English.
